title: Board Composition & Independent Directors
question_text: Under Regulation 17(1)(b), what proportion of the Board must comprise Independent Directors if the Chairperson is a promoter or executive director?
explanation: Regulation 17(1)(b) mandates that where the chairperson of the board of directors is a promoter or an executive director, at least half (50%) of the board of directors shall consist of independent directors.

title: Audit Committee Mandates & Composition
question_text: What is the minimum proportion of Independent Directors required on the Audit Committee of a listed entity under Regulation 18(1)(b)?
explanation: Regulation 18(1)(b) provides that at least two-thirds of the members of audit committee shall be independent directors.

title: Related Party Transactions Framework (Regulation 23)
question_text: Under Regulation 23, what threshold defines a "Material Related Party Transaction" requiring prior shareholder approval?

options.text: Value exceeding ₹500 Crores or 5% of turnover
Value exceeding ₹1,000 Crores or 10% of annual consolidated turnover

explanation: Regulation 23(1) provides that a transaction with a related party shall be considered material if it exceeds ₹1,000 crore or 10 per cent of the annual consolidated turnover of the listed entity, whichever is lower.
option_b: Value exceeding ₹500 Crores or 5% of turnover
option_c: Value exceeding ₹1,000 Crores or 10% of annual consolidated turnover

title: Prior Intimations & Closure of Trading Window
question_text: Under Regulation 29(2), how many clear days of prior intimation must be given to stock exchanges for a Board meeting considering financial results?
topic_name: Prior Intimations & Closure of Trading Window
explanation: Regulation 29(2) mandates that prior intimation for financial results board meetings shall be given at least 5 clear days in advance (excluding the date of the intimation and date of the meeting).

title: Disclosure of Material Events & Information (Regulation 30)
question_text: Within what timeframe must the outcome of a Board Meeting considering dividends or financial results be disclosed to stock exchanges under Regulation 30(6)?

options.text: Within 30 minutes of closure of the meeting
Within 2 hours of closure of the meeting
Within 12 hours of closure of the meeting
Within 24 hours of closure of the meeting

explanation: Regulation 30(6) requires that the listed entity shall disclose the outcome of the Board meeting within thirty (30) minutes of the closure of the meeting.
option_a: Within 30 minutes of closure of the meeting
option_b: Within 2 hours of closure of the meeting
option_c: Within 12 hours of closure of the meeting
option_d: Within 24 hours of closure of the meeting

title: Financial Results & Limited Review Reports (Reg 33)
question_text: Within how many days from the end of the quarter must a listed entity submit its quarterly financial results under Regulation 33(3)(a)?
explanation: Regulation 33(3)(a) mandates that quarterly financial results shall be submitted to the stock exchange within 45 days of end of each quarter, other than the last quarter.

title: Secretarial Audit & Annual Compliance Report (Reg 24A)
question_text: Within how many days from the end of the financial year must the Annual Secretarial Compliance Report (ASCR) be submitted to stock exchanges?
explanation: Under Regulation 24A, listed entities must submit an annual secretarial compliance report issued by a PCS to stock exchanges within sixty days from the end of each financial year.

title: Shareholding Pattern & Statement of Deviations (Reg 31 & 32)
question_text: Within how many days from the end of each quarter must the Shareholding Pattern be submitted under Regulation 31(1)(b)?
explanation: Regulation 31(1)(b) provides that the shareholding pattern shall be submitted quarterly within 21 days from the end of each quarter.

title: Nomination & Remuneration Committee (NRC - Reg 19)
question_text: Who among the following CANNOT chair the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC) of a listed entity?
explanation: Regulation 19(2) explicitly provides that the chairperson of the listed entity, whether executive or non-executive, shall not chair the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

title: Stakeholders Relationship & Risk Management Committees
question_text: Under Regulation 21(3A), how many times must the Risk Management Committee (RMC) meet in a financial year?
explanation: Regulation 21(3A) mandates that the Risk Management Committee shall meet at least twice in a year, with not more than 180 days intervening between two meetings.

title: Corporate Governance Report & Annual Report (Reg 27 & 34)
question_text: Within how many days from the end of each quarter must the Corporate Governance Compliance Report be filed under Regulation 27(2)?
explanation: Regulation 27(2)(a) stipulates that the listed entity shall submit a quarterly compliance report on corporate governance to the recognized stock exchange(s) within 21 days from the end of each quarter.

regulatory_reference.provision: Regulation 27, Regulation 34 & Schedule V, SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

title: Website Disclosures & Record Keeping (Reg 46 & 62)
question_text: Within what timeframe must any change in the contents of the website be updated under Regulation 46(3)?
explanation: Regulation 46(3) mandates that the listed entity shall update any change in the content of its website within two (2) working days from the date of such change in content.
